title: applyLists does not reconcile pending list saves on a record re-read
evidence: widget-src/src/hooks/useRecordApply.ts apply calls applyLists(result), which sets the medications, screenings and supplements the read returned; a medication, screening or supplement save still waiting on its 300 ms timer in widget-src/src/hooks/useListSaves.ts (medSaves, screeningSaves, supplementSaves) is neither flushed, dropped nor laid back over the read. So a whole re-read inside that window shows the stored list, then the waiting save lands, and the screen keeps the list from before the edit while the record holds the edit. Every refused-save re-read (reread 'refused' / 'left') shares it; lead A6 (PR 1382) keeps an aborted erase from re-reading unless it refused a save, and US-16 AC2a names the rest as a Limit. Found by Codex on PR 1382 (R1, a dose changed just before Delete all my data)
